card.name: Heading words and 'in' after study
card.fires_on: The word 'in' right after 'a study' or 'clinical study' that introduces a study population. It also fires on the end of a section heading or a long medical term, such as 'provider' in 'health care provider', 'Impairment', and 'Carcinogenesis'.

modes.label: 'in' after study
modes.description: The word 'in' directly after 'study' that introduces the volunteers or patients studied.

modes.description: The last piece of a heading or a multi-part medical term, just before the text that follows.
